settings.label: Enable click sound feature
settings.info: Master switch — when off, the sound toggle button and all click sounds are completely removed from the storefront.

settings.label: Sound file URL
settings.info: Upload your .mp3 or .wav file to Settings → Files, copy its URL, and paste it here.

settings.label: Sound volume
settings.info: Controls how loud the click sound plays.

settings.label: Toggle button position
settings.info: Where the sound on/off button appears on the storefront.

settings.label: Sound on by default for new visitors
settings.info: If checked, sound will be ON the first time a visitor arrives (before they toggle it). Returning visitors keep their own preference.

settings.label: Enable background music feature
settings.info: Master switch — when off, the music toggle button and audio are completely removed from the storefront.

settings.label: Music file URL
settings.info: Upload your .mp3 or .wav file to Settings → Files, copy its URL, and paste it here.

settings.label: Music volume
settings.info: Controls how loud the background music plays.

settings.label: Toggle button position
settings.info: Where the music on/off button appears on the storefront.

settings.label: Distance from click sound button
settings.info: How far away from the edge (or click sound button) this button sits. Useful when both buttons are in the same corner.

settings.label: Try to autoplay for returning visitors
settings.info: If a visitor previously enabled music, try to resume it automatically on next visit. First-time visitors always need to click the button (browser rules).

settings.content: A neumorphic loading animation that appears when visitors navigate between pages. It does not appear on page reloads or direct URL visits.

settings.label: Extra display time
settings.info: Additional time (in milliseconds) the loader stays visible after the page finishes loading. 0 is the fastest. Higher values create a more dramatic entrance.
